title: Terrible customer service
text: Terrible customer service. The machine worked for two weeks then broke down.  The back and forth correspondence with TBeco customer service has been pointless.  I won't recommend this product to anybody.

product_metadata.title: Beko Turkish Coffee Maker, 120V Coffee Brewing Machine, 2-Cup Capacity, 100% BPA Free, Excellent Taste with Cooksense Technology, Ready in 3 Minutes
features: PERFECT COFFEE EVERY TIME: BEKO's CookSense brewing technology gives you the consistency and excellent taste you are looking for in every cup.
DELICIOUS DOUBLE FOAM: The Turkish Coffee Maker follows a traditional brewing method with a precise temperature to prepare an excellent cup of Turkish coffee with extra foam.

READY IN 3 MINUTES: It takes only three minutes to prepare two perfect cups of Turkish coffee and enjoy right in your home. The sound and light indicators will simply notify the stages of preparation.
EASY TO CLEAN: The brewing pot can be easily removed, cleaned, and hand-washed.
120V PLUG: The Turkish Coffee Maker is designed for North American electrical outlets, and does not require any additional adapters to use.
